provenance: Independent exact original-line formulas; written after proof exposure to verify the claimed zero-area allowance. No author checker used.
period8_direct_construction: For r>1 set x=(r²−1)/(r²+1), y=2r/(r²+1), a²=(r−1)³(r+1)/(4r), b=1. Outer vertices (a,0),(ax,y),(0,1),(−ax,y),(−a,0),(−ax,−y),(0,−1),(ax,−y). Both first-quadrant chords tangent to same confocal caustic lambda=a²/(a²+r²). Reflection and axis symmetries propagate, making a convex primitive period-eight billiard. Over r in[3,5] a²>1 and lambda in(0,1), and every focal normal determinant is nonzero.
conclusion: Signed antipedal area is continuous on r in[3,5], changes sign, and thus vanishes for at least one admissible primitive period-eight pair. This existence statement is exact, independent of numerical root identification and of the product proof.
